name: MATLAB test job

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      group:
        description: Name used in the job summary and diagnostic artifact
        required: true
        type: string
      folders:
        description: Semicolon-separated test folders
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  tests:
    name: ${{ inputs.group }} (R2024a)
    # R2024a supports Ubuntu 22.04; pin the image to avoid ubuntu-latest drift.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      MATLAB_RELEASE: R2024a
      CI_GROUP: ${{ inputs.group }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out YALMIP
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare diagnostics
        id: diagnostics
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p ci-results
          {
            echo "MATLAB: $MATLAB_RELEASE"
            echo "Runner: $RUNNER_OS / $RUNNER_ARCH"
            uname -a
            git rev-parse HEAD
          } > ci-results/environment.txt

      - name: Check CI reporting
        id: reporting
        run: node .github/scripts/ci-summary.test.cjs

      - name: Check out SeDuMi
        id: sedumi
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: sqlp/sedumi
          path: sedumi
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Record SeDuMi revision
        id: revision
        run: git -C sedumi rev-parse HEAD >> ci-results/environment.txt

      - name: Install MATLAB and required toolboxes
        id: setup
        uses: matlab-actions/setup-matlab@v3
        with:
          release: ${{ env.MATLAB_RELEASE }}
          products: Optimization_Toolbox Control_System_Toolbox
          cache: true

      - name: Check MATLAB startup and toolbox license
        id: preflight
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: matlab-actions/run-command@v3
        with:
          startup-options: -logfile ${{ github.workspace }}/ci-results/preflight.log
          command: >-
            disp(version); ver;
            [ok, message] = license('checkout', 'Optimization_Toolbox');
            assert(ok, 'YALMIP:CI:License', '%s', message);
            assert(exist('fmincon', 'file') == 2, 'Optimization Toolbox is not installed');
            assert(exist('lqr', 'file') == 2, 'Control System Toolbox is not installed');
            disp('MATLAB startup and required toolboxes OK');

      - name: Build SeDuMi
        id: build
        timeout-minutes: 15
        uses: matlab-actions/run-command@v3
        with:
          startup-options: -logfile ${{ github.workspace }}/ci-results/sedumi.log
          command: cd('sedumi'); install_sedumi('-rebuild');

      - name: Run tests
        id: tests
        uses: matlab-actions/run-tests@v3
        with:
          source-folder: .
          select-by-folder: ${{ inputs.folders }}
          startup-options: -logfile ${{ github.workspace }}/ci-results/tests.log
          test-results-junit: ci-results/tests.xml
          output-detail: detailed
          # Test details are useful; automatic coverage instrumentation is costly.
          code-coverage-metrics: ''
          generate-summary: true

      - name: Upload logs and test results
        id: artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.group }}-R2024a-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ci-results/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-f

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
